name: Moses
summary: The man God sent to bring Israel out of bondage in Egypt. He led the people through the sea, received God's law at Mount Sinai, and died within sight of the promised land.

key_moments.title: Saved from the River
key_moments.description: His mother hid him for three months, then laid him in an ark of bulrushes by the river. Pharaoh's daughter found him, raised him as her son, and named him Moses.

key_moments.title: Called from the Burning Bush
key_moments.description: While keeping Jethro's flock at Horeb, Moses saw a bush on fire that did not burn up. God called to him from it and sent him to bring Israel out of Egypt.

key_moments.title: Leads Israel Through the Sea
key_moments.description: Moses held out his hand, and the LORD drove the sea back so Israel crossed on dry ground. When the Egyptians followed, the waters came back and covered them.

key_moments.title: Called Up Mount Sinai
key_moments.description: Amid thunder, fire and smoke, the LORD came down on Mount Sinai and called Moses up. God spoke His commandments, and the frightened people begged Moses to speak to them instead.

key_moments.title: Seeing the Land from Nebo
key_moments.description: From Mount Nebo the LORD showed Moses the land promised to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, but told him he would not go over into it. Moses died there in Moab at 120 years old, and Israel mourned him thirty days.
